name: Yellowtail
siboNotes: Plain yellowtail is excellent for SIBO as it's naturally FODMAP-free and provides easily digestible protein without feeding bacterial overgrowth.
preparationTips: Grill, bake, or pan-sear with FODMAP-friendly seasonings like salt, pepper, and herbs
Avoid marinades containing garlic, onion, or high FODMAP ingredients
Pair with low FODMAP vegetables and grains for complete meals
Fresh yellowtail is ideal - check that processed versions don't contain FODMAP additives
nutritionalHighlights: High in omega-3 fatty acids for heart and brain health
Excellent source of complete protein with all essential amino acids
Rich in B vitamins, especially B12 and niacin
Good source of selenium and potassium
